_comment: Single source of truth for regulatory thresholds. Do NOT hard-code these values elsewhere. Re-verify each value at its citation and update last_verified when you do.

davis_bacon_threshold.note: Davis-Bacon prevailing wages apply to federal construction contracts above this amount.

payment_protection_pct.note: Alternative payment protection: 100% of contract price.

payment_protection_days.note: Payment protection must be furnished within this window.

miller_act_threshold.note: Performance and payment bonds required above this amount.

naics_237110_size_standard.note: Small business size standard for water and sewer line construction.

subcontract_limit_pct.unit: fraction of contract amount excluding materials
subcontract_limit_pct.note: General construction set-asides: no more than 85% may be paid to non-similarly-situated subcontractors, excluding materials. Work sent to a similarly situated small business does not count against the limit.

debrief_request_days.citation: FAR 15.506(a)(1) (analog for simplified: FAR 13.106-3(d) brief explanation)
debrief_request_days.note: Request a debriefing/brief explanation promptly; 3 days preserves rights.

ok811_business_days.note: Call OKIE811 at least 2 business days (48 hours excluding weekends/holidays) before digging.

record_retention_years.note: Retain payrolls and basic records for all laborers/mechanics for 3 years after completion.

certified_payroll_weekly.note: Certified payroll due weekly for every week of contract performance, including zero-work weeks.

ot_multiplier.unit: multiple of basic rate over 40 hrs/week
ot_multiplier.note: Overtime at 1.5x basic rate (fringe stays at straight rate) over 40 hours/week.

fica_rate.note: Default employee FICA withholding used when no explicit amount entered.

micro_purchase_threshold_construction.citation: FAR 2.101 (micro-purchase threshold, construction subject to 40 U.S.C. ch. 31 subch. IV)
micro_purchase_threshold_construction.note: Construction micro-purchase threshold is 2,000 USD (Davis-Bacon linkage).

policy_notes.prompt_payment_discount: Prompt payment discounts are NOT considered in price evaluation at IHS OKC Area Office. Never offer one - it gives away margin for zero evaluation credit.
policy_notes.iee_rep_form: IEE Representation form (HHSAR 352.226-7) required with every quote to IHS.
policy_notes.differing_site_conditions: FAR 52.236-2 Differing Site Conditions: if you hit rock or subsurface conditions materially different from the solicitation, STOP, document, and notify the CO in writing before disturbing the condition. This is the equitable-adjustment mechanism.
